_howto: Elections polled by the Enhanced Voting adapter (server/src/adapters/enhancedvoting.js). host = the results site's host, slug = the jurisdiction slug in /results/public/{slug}, publicElectionId = elections[].publicElectionId from GET https://{host}/results/public/api/jurisdictions/{slug}. counties:false = emit statewide units only (RI reports by town and the source doesn't say which county a town is in). Set enabled:false to stop polling one without deleting it.
_contestRulesHowto: Contest-name rules for this source's own naming, tried before the shared config/contest-rules.json (server/src/contests.js). match = case-insensitive regex on the folded name (lower case, commas and parentheses turned into spaces). Found in the 2026-11-03 live /data payloads.

contestRules.note: GA: District Attorney - Columbia Judicial Circuit (the word judicial would otherwise make it a judge)
RI: Senator in General Assembly District 1
RI towns: "Exeter: Town Moderator", "Cumberland: Non-Partisan Fire Committee District 1"
